exposure: MRI-compatible NO delivery method (NO blender in control room with 12m tubing to ventilator in scanner room)
cohort: An infant test lung simulating patients of differing weights (4 kg, 10 kg, 20 kg) connected to a ventilator.
finding: The bench test demonstrated that the described system can safely generate a range of NO concentrations (15-42 ppm) and F<inf>IO2</inf> values (0.34-0.98) in clinical use, though the additional flow increased delivered peak inspiratory pressure and PEEP by 1-5 cm H<inf>2</inf>O.
